output_text:
import os
import requests

def diarized_transcript(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.getenv("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("Missing AssemblyAI API key. Set ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY or pass config['api_key'].")

    headers = {
        "authorization": api_key,
        "content-type": "application/json",
    }

    upload_url = payload.get("audio_url")
    if not upload_url and payload.get("audio_bytes"):
        upload_resp = requests.post(
            "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/upload",
            headers={"authorization": api_key},
            data=payload["audio_bytes"],
            timeout=config.get("timeout", 60),
        )
        upload_resp.raise_for_status()
        upload_url = upload_resp.json()["upload_url"]

    if not upload_url:
        raise ValueError("payload must include 'audio_url' or 'audio_bytes'.")

    transcript_req = {
        "audio_url": upload_url,
        "speaker_labels": True,
        "punctuate": config.get("punctuate", True),
        "format_text": config.get("format_text", True),
    }

    create_resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript",
        headers=headers,
        json=transcript_req,
        timeout=config.get("timeout", 60),
    )
    create_resp.raise_for_status()
    transcript_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    status_url = f"https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/{transcript_id}"
    timeout = config.get("timeout", 60)
    poll_interval = config.get("poll_interval", 3)

    while True:
        status_resp = requests.get(status_url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
        status_resp.raise_for_status()
        data = status_resp.json()
        status = data.get("status")

        if status == "completed":
            result = {
                "id": data.get("id"),
                "status": status,
                "text": data.get("text"),
                "utterances": data.get("utterances", []),
                "words": data.get("words", []),
            }
            return result

        if status == "error":
            raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "AssemblyAI transcription failed"))

        import time
        time.sleep(poll_interval)
